A pull request is a proposed change. It does not become the book until a human chooses to merge it.

## What changed?

<!-- Describe the visible change in simple words. -->

<!-- Identity can continue across change. Say what you believe survived. -->

## Observer readback

- [ ] I looked at the old version.
- [ ] I looked at the new version.
- [ ] I described what I actually noticed.
- [ ] I am willing to say “I am not sure.”

How sure am I that I saw the important change?

- [ ] A tiny bit
- [ ] Sort of
- [ ] Very much
- [ ] Not sure yet

Who made this change? Choose exactly one.

- [ ] Human-authored
- [ ] Agent-assisted
- [ ] Agent-authored

## Path check

- [ ] This changes a picture.
- [ ] This changes words.
- [ ] This may change the path or promise.
- [ ] I do not know whether the path or promise changed.

## Human boundary

- [ ] I am the responsible grown-up, and I have reviewed my own changes.
- [ ] No child's personal information is included.
- [ ] I understand that passing machine checks does not authorize this change.

> Machines check the pawprints. Humans decide what belongs in the story.
